data.body: Correction to the earlier "Windows sweep: not needed" note. The Windows sweep of run 44456347985 (job 135332660982, main at ab323f7df0c) failed this change's 4 tests with UnicodeDecodeError, because they read files without naming an encoding: test_orphaned_processes_guidance.py::test_the_source_still_has_detached_workers_to_name, ::test_guidance_names_every_spawn_detached_worker[AGENTS.md] and [docs/orphaned-processes.md], and test_check_orphaned_load.py::test_worker_modules_match_the_sources_spawn_detached_sites. The encoding class was fixed by obtuse-phenocryst-verdin (535e09284d3). In the sweep of run 44487190183 (job 135433617476, main at 3f47117c97b), all 4 pass. The product change (guidance plus a string matcher) is unaffected; only the tests' file reads were Windows-sensitive.
